Privacy Policy Last Updated

Effective Date

May 26, 2026

1. Information We Collect

Sterrocloud may collect customer information including account details, billing information, email addresses, IP addresses, infrastructure usage logs, device identifiers, service activity, and operational analytics required for infrastructure management and service delivery.

2. How Information Is Used

Customer information is used to provide hosting services, process invoices, manage infrastructure deployments, improve platform stability, communicate operational updates, prevent abuse, and maintain security across Sterrocloud systems.

3. Cookies & Analytics

Sterrocloud platforms may utilize cookies, analytics systems, session tracking technologies, and performance monitoring tools to improve platform functionality, optimize infrastructure performance, and enhance user experience.

4. Data Security

Sterrocloud implements infrastructure security measures including access controls, encrypted communications, monitoring systems, authentication protection, and operational safeguards designed to reduce unauthorized access risks and protect customer data.

5. Third-Party Services

Certain Sterrocloud services may integrate with third-party providers including payment gateways, infrastructure vendors, analytics platforms, communication systems, and cloud-based technologies required for operational functionality and service delivery.

6. Infrastructure Monitoring

Infrastructure systems may automatically collect operational logs, network telemetry, service metrics, and infrastructure performance data to maintain uptime, detect abuse patterns, improve security, and optimize platform reliability.

7. Customer Rights

Customers may request access to account-related information, billing records, or infrastructure data associated with their services. Requests involving account security, operational compliance, or legal obligations may require identity verification before processing.

8. Contact Information

Questions regarding privacy practices, infrastructure security, customer information, or operational compliance may be directed to Sterrocloud through official communication channels listed on the Contact page.
